newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 72.0 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 72.0 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it had allocated 72.0 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent, the rate that has prevailed since late August.
A repo pact for 74.2 billion marks at a fixed three percent percent expires today, Wednesday, so a net 2.2 billion marks is draining from the money market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 234.3 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 30.75 percent of the bids made.
